p.br:
Made by Bunni (almondjosh)
Full desktop-style operating system in a single page, with a real Ultraviolet web proxy behind it. Browser, Games, Movies, Music, Chat, AI, and a full theme system — all running client-side, backed by a Node.js Bare/Wisp server for proxying.
Uses Ultraviolet, BareMux, and Epoxy for the proxy layer, and Firebase Realtime Database for Bonfire sync.

br.br: Bonfire uses Firebase Realtime Database with a "send the whole blob" sync model. If two people send messages at the exact same moment, one message can overwrite the other.
AI Hub uses Groq's free API. Sign up at console.groq.com, create a key, then paste it into the GROQ_KEY constant near the top of the AI section in tux.html.
